I read the ruling again and, it seems to me,the intent of the card is as follows:

1) At the beginning of the turn, the card will DEAL certain upkeep damage. 

2) This damage is no different than any other damage dealt in the game. It is modifiable, transferable, etc. 

3) This damage amount also indicates the minimum amount of damage, dealt by this card, that must be taken by the hero in order to keep the card. 

4) The type of damage is not part of this upkeep requirement (i.e. it can be changed to some other type without impact to the upkeep condition). 

 

So there are really two semi-independent parts to the upkeep:

A) The card deals damage. 

B) A minimum amount of damage must be dealt to the hero by the card in order to keep the card. 

 

Based on this set up, and the rules as the exist, I believe the wording on the cards should be:

[Card] deals [hero] X [type] damage. If [hero] is dealt less than X damage by [card], destroy [card]. 

I think that should be clear enough.
